messages:
courtney_docs: Heads up - we need a concise playbook for the staggered sunset of v1 endpoints across regions. TL;DR: per-region dates, SDK notes, redirects, and minimal code examples. Who can take the lead on the SDK snippets?

sam_docs: I can take JS + Python snippets. I'll add a short note about the request param rename that trips people.

rita_eng: I’ll handle the runtime-side note about model swap fallbacks (what the service returns when a pinned model is gone). Need one small example showing graceful retry.

courtney_docs: Awesome. Also need a short section for customers on expected error codes and which are safe to auto-retry vs show to users. Put that under an FAQ.

sam_docs: Draft plan: make a single doc page /docs/sunset/v1-staggered that has: 1) timeline table per-region, 2) SDK migration snippets, 3) redirect map + PR checklist, 4) evals and smoke tests to run. Will open PR tomorrow.

ingrid_release: Important: Dedicated customers in eu-west-1 have a later freeze date (see contract). We should call that out and add a per-customer note for sales. Also make sure the redirect map supports region-scoped aliasing.

rita_eng: Quick example for graceful retry to paste into the doc:```
// pseudocode
resp = call_v2_with_fallback(payload)
if resp.status == 404 and resp.body.error == "model_unavailable":
  wait(100)
  resp = call_v2_with_compatible_model(payload)
```

sam_docs: Nice. For SDK examples, do we want to show the new `model` alias vs the old `model_alias` param? I propose showing both with a note: "old param is deprecated - use model".

courtney_docs: Yes — one table showing old -> new param mapping. Also include a tiny code block demonstrating streaming framing change in v2, since that confused a few customers during the beta.

sam_docs: Streaming snippet for Node:```
const stream = client.streaming.chat.connect({ model: 'redwood-1000', messages: [...] })
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  if (chunk.type === 'token') process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
  if (chunk.type === 'meta' && chunk.meta.event === 'end') console.log('\n-- stream end --')
}
```

rita_eng: FYI: runtime will send `meta:event=end` instead of the old EOF sentinel. Add that under "Breaking changes".

ingrid_release: Two operational asks: 1) Add a docs PR label `sunset/v1` so QE and support can triage; 2) create a smoke-test checklist that QE can run by region.

courtney_docs: I'll add the label and the initial checklist file. Sam: please include the redirect YAML snippet (how to add a 301 redirect) — that will help docs reviewers.

sam_docs: Redirect example (YAML) to paste in the PR:```
- from: "/v1/models/*"
  to: "/v2/models/*"
  status: 301
  scope: region
```

deploy-bot: deploy/redirects updated by sam_docs — preview site available at https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/v1-sunset (preview build 3256). :rocket:

rita_eng: One more edge-case to document: embedding dimension changes between models. Add a note that stored vectors may need reindexing and provide a short command to run reindex in the CLI.

sam_docs: Good call. I'll add a short troubleshooting snippet for embeddings mismatch and a note to reach out to eng for migration windows.

courtney_docs: Great progress. Action items recap: sam_docs - open PR with JS/Python snippets + redirect YAML + embeddings note; rita_eng - add graceful retry and runtime semantics section; ingrid_release - confirm per-region dates and update sales playbook; courtney_docs - add label + smoke-test checklist. Target: PRs merged 3 business days before eu-west freeze.

ritа_eng: ack (typo in name fixed)

sam_docs: Starting the PR now, will ping this thread when preview is up. :working_on_it:
